cover.main: THIS IS WHERE SOUTH FLORIDA GOES OUT

photo.query: South Florida nightlife crowd venue palm trees stage lights
photo.prompt: A dramatic South Florida night crowd outside a lit venue with palm trees, stage lights, and people walking in

slides.headline: Good Night John Boy opens in Fort Lauderdale
slides.body: The 1970s-themed bar opened Nov. 6 at 270 SE Sixth Ave. in Fort Lauderdale. It has nightly DJs, a dance floor, and cocktails including Disco Punch in a take-home cup.

photo.query: disco ball cocktail bar Fort Lauderdale nightlife
photo.prompt: A 1970s-style disco bar with mirrored disco balls, neon lights, wood paneling, and cocktails on a crowded dance floor

slides.headline: North Miami Greek Festival at the Greek Orthodox Church of the Annunciation
slides.body: The festival runs Friday, Nov. 6 at the Greek Orthodox Church of the Annunciation, 12250 NW Second Ave., North Miami. Admission is free with RSVP.

photo.query: Greek festival food music church grounds North Miami
photo.prompt: A festival scene with Greek food, music, and dancing on church grounds under string lights

slides.headline: Subtropic Film Festival opens its fourth installment
slides.body: The festival opens Friday, Nov. 6 at various venues across Miami. Tickets cost $10 to $30, and the opening block is 'Homegrown,' a set of five short films.

photo.query: independent film festival screening audience Miami
photo.prompt: A dark theater with a film screen, audience silhouettes, and a festival poster near the entrance

slides.headline: Jazz at Pinecrest Gardens on Nov. 7
slides.body: The 17th Annual Jazz at Pinecrest Gardens starts Saturday, Nov. 7 at 8 p.m. at Pinecrest Gardens, 11000 Red Road, Pinecrest. Tickets cost $45 to $60.

photo.query: jazz performance outdoor garden stage night Pinecrest
photo.prompt: An outdoor jazz performance at night in a garden setting with a singer, band, and stage lights

slides.headline: Rocky Dale Davis at Ft. Lauderdale Improv on Nov. 8
slides.body: The comedian performs Sunday, Nov. 8 at 6 p.m. at the Ft. Lauderdale Improv, 177 N. Pointe Drive, Dania Beach. Tickets cost $31.90.

photo.query: comedy club stage microphone spotlight audience
photo.prompt: A comedy club stage with a single microphone under a spotlight and a packed audience in a dark room

slides.headline: Fall for Dance Now! at Miami Beach Bandshell on Nov. 8
slides.body: Dance Now! Miami performs Sunday, Nov. 8 at 7 p.m. at Miami Beach Bandshell, 7275 Collins Ave., Miami Beach. Tickets cost $10 to $25.

photo.query: Miami Beach Bandshell performance stage night dance
photo.prompt: A dramatic outdoor dance performance on the Miami Beach Bandshell stage at night with colorful lights
